notes.title: Seaburn Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’ve just released patch 1.0.3, addressing bugs and adding more content. Here are the changes:

Added animation for opening or creating a save file
Added more content for the social media system
Fixed issue where the same legislation can be encountered twice within a short amount of time
Fixed minor spelling issues
Other minor bug fixes

If you think you have a cool feature you'd like us to add, or if you found a bug with our game, feel free to reach out at treeburnstudios@athenas.dev or DM us on Instagram at @tree.burn.

notes.title: Seaburn Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

Patch 1.0.2 has arrived! In this patch, we have fixed many bugs and added some features. 

Minor balancing changes
Minor aesthetic changes
Improved back buttons
Removed pause menu in certain scenes
Added indicator for when there are no events in the current week
Fixed bug where event options could be clicked too early
Fixed bug where the election counter would be displayed abnormally during week 1
Fixed bug where the tooltip would behave abnormally on first launch

If you think you have a cool feature you'd like us to add, or if you found a bug with our game, feel free to reach out at treeburnstudios@athenas.dev or DM us on Instagram at @tree.burn.
